weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP = 100% at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on foe and neutralizes unit's penalties to Atk/Res during combat, and also, if foe is colorless and uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants weapon-triangle advantage to unit and inflicts weapon-triangle disadvantage on foe during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Def/Res+1 to ally with the highest Def+Res total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Def/Res+3 to ally with the highest Def+Res total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Def/Res+5 to ally with the highest Def+Res total for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
